OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must then contain exactly 10
            digits; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[^0-9]*([0-9][^0-9]*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's upper-cased first-name and last-name initials, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must then contain exactly 10
            digits; the normalized 10-digit value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[^0-9]*([0-9][^0-9]*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's upper-cased first-name and last-name initials, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

The spec: on `POST /api/owners`, when no `registrationDate` is supplied, default it to the server's current date, and always return `registrationDate` in ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` form (preserving a supplied date otherwise).

Changes, kept small and cohesive to minimize structural impact:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `registrationDate` field (`type: string, format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Because `Owner` is `allOf` `OwnerFields`, the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` now accept it on input and return it on output as `LocalDate` (serialized as `YYYY-MM-DD`), and MapStruct maps it automatically by name — so no controller or mapper edits were needed.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added the `registrationDate` field + getter/setter, plus one small `@PrePersist` method that defaults it to `LocalDate.now()` only when null. With `IDENTITY` id generation the insert (and thus the callback) fires immediately on save, so both the create response and the later GET see the value. A supplied date flows through untouched.

3. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** and **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — added the `registration_date DATE` column (the test profile uses hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema is authoritative) and padded the positional seed inserts with a null value. I followed the existing convention where only the hsqldb schema is kept in sync with the entity (the h2/mysql/postgres schemas already omit `email`; h2, the default runtime profile, uses `ddl-auto=update` and self-adds the column).

The default logic lives in one tiny, low-complexity method inside the entity rather than being threaded through the large controller or mapper.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added the `registrationDate` field + getter/setter, plus one small `@PrePersist` method that defaults it to `LocalDate.now()` only when null. With `IDENTITY` id generation the insert (and thus the callback) fires immediately on save, so both the create response and the later GET see the value. A supplied date flows through untouched.

3. **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** and **`db/hsqldb/data.sql`** — added the `registration_date DATE` column (the test profile uses hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema is authoritative) and padded the positional seed inserts with a null value. I followed the existing convention where only the hsqldb schema is kept in sync with the entity (the h2/mysql/postgres schemas already omit `email`; h2, the default runtime profile, uses `ddl-auto=update` and self-adds the column).

The default logic lives in one tiny, low-complexity method inside the entity rather than being threaded through the large controller or mapper.
